1. Mr. Sanjay Raturi, learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
2. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned Deputy Advocate 
General for the State. 
3. Mr. Rakshit Srivastva, learned counsel 
holding brief of Mr. Ramji Srivastava, learned 
counsel for respondent No. 2. 
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits 
that another similar appeal, being Special 
Appeal No. 57 of 2023, is pending disposal. 
He prays that the present appeal be also listed 
along with the said appeal. 
5. Issue notice to the respondents on the 
application seeking condonation of delay.

accept notice.

seeking condonation of delay may be filed 
before the next date.

SPA No. 57 of 2023.
